cat > project.yml <<'EOF'
name: SimControl
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: local.simcontrol
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "16.0"
targets:
  SimControl:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - Host
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.simcontrol.host
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
  SimControlUITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    sources:
      - UITests
    dependencies:
      - target: SimControl
    settings:
      PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: local.simcontrol.uitests
      TEST_TARGET_NAME: SimControl
      GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
EOF
cat > Host/HostApp.swift <<'EOF'
import SwiftUI
@main struct HostApp: App {
    var body: some Scene { WindowGroup { Text("Host") } }
}
EOF
cat > UITests/RoomSearchTests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest
final class RoomSearchTests: XCTestCase {
    func testRoomSearch() {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        let room = app.staticTexts["Team Standup"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(room.waitForExistence(timeout: 15), app.debugDescription)
        room.tap()
        sleep(3)
        print("ROOM TREE START\n\(app.debugDescription)\nROOM TREE END")
        XCTAssertTrue(true)
    }
}
EOF
